ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:5 ratio of high-intensity (light grey/white) to low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (dark) mass occupying the central and proximal regions; high-intensity mottling and focal white speckling concentrated in the distal 25% of both lobes, particularly at the margins and tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 115 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (3-7 pixel depth) along the trailing boundary, with more pronounced irregular peaks and valleys located at the distal-most sections of the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A convex leading edge sweep coupled with a trailing edge that exhibits a slight concavity transitioning to an upward convex curve at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and along the distal margin of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular tissue accumulations and marginal erosion at both lobe tips consistent with persistent barnacle colonization or significant localized trauma.
